20261122-chemistry-g10-1.material: [Advanced molecular structure] Among molecules formed by period 2 nonmetal elements that satisfy the octet rule (8 outermost electrons), which choice correctly pairs the numbers of shared (bonding) electron pairs and unshared (lone) electron pairs of methane (CH₄), ammonia (NH₃), and water (H₂O)?
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.prompt: [Advanced molecular structure] Among molecules formed by period 2 nonmetal elements that satisfy the octet rule (8 outermost electrons), which choice correctly pairs the numbers of shared (bonding) electron pairs and unshared (lone) electron pairs of methane (CH₄), ammonia (NH₃), and water (H₂O)?
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.explain: Methane ($\text{CH}_4$) has $4$ shared pairs and $0$ lone pairs. Ammonia ($\text{NH}_3$), because of the intrinsic nature of nitrogen, has $3$ shared pairs and $1$ lone pair, and water ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$) has $2$ shared pairs and $2$ lone pairs.
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.hint.0: Carbon (C) has 4 valence electrons and forms covalent bonds with all 4 hydrogens.
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.hint.1: Nitrogen (N) shares 3 of its 5 and the other 2 form 1 lone pair. Oxygen (O) shares 2 of its 6 and the other 4 form 2 lone pairs.
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.o.o0: CH₄: shared 4, lone 0 / NH₃: shared 3, lone 1 / H₂O: shared 2, lone 2
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.o.o1: CH₄: shared 4, lone 4 / NH₃: shared 3, lone 2 / H₂O: shared 2, lone 0
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.o.o2: CH₄: shared 2, lone 2 / NH₃: shared 3, lone 0 / H₂O: shared 4, lone 1

20261122-chemistry-g10-2.topic: Which environmental problem is caused when
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.goal: Sebenzisa izimiso ze-Which environmental problem is caused when ukuxazulula inkinga yophenyo.
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.material: Which environmental problem is caused when sulfur dioxide (SO₂) or nitrogen oxides (NOx) released from burning fossil fuels react with water vapor in the atmosphere to form sulfuric acid or nitric acid, lowering the pH of rainwater below the normal value (about 5.6)?
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.thinking.0: Which environmental problem is caused when
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.prompt: Which environmental problem is caused when sulfur dioxide (SO₂) or nitrogen oxides (NOx) released from burning fossil fuels react with water vapor in the atmosphere to form sulfuric acid or nitric acid, lowering the pH of rainwater below the normal value (about 5.6)?
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.explain: Sulfur oxides and nitrogen oxides react with water in the atmosphere to produce the strong acids sulfuric acid ($\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$) and nitric acid ($\text{HNO}_3$), which brings strongly acidic rain with $\text{pH} < 5.6$ that acidifies soil and lakes.
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.hint.0: When nonmetal oxides in the atmosphere dissolve in water, they become acidic.
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.hint.1: It refers to rain with a pH below 5.6.
